brief_en: Vistra leads the week: the ERCOT large-load ESA signature (SIG-2026-11-000118) plus raised capacity-price guidance lift momentum. Watch the next ERCOT study cycle.
brief_zh: Vistra 领跑本周：ERCOT 大负荷并网协议签署（SIG-2026-11-000118）叠加容量价格指引上调，动量走强。关注下一轮 ERCOT 研究周期。

brief_en: GE Vernova holds second place: grid-equipment demand stays tight as two large-load transitions cleared this week.
brief_zh: GE Vernova 位列第二：本周两个大负荷并网推进后，电网设备需求保持紧张。

brief_en: Equinix slips on valuation despite the Loudoun approval; permit strength is real but partly priced.
brief_zh: 尽管劳登县批准落地，Equinix 因估值回落；许可面利好真实但已部分定价。

brief_en: Constellation holds a top slot on nuclear PAA momentum despite the CAISO co-location withdrawal touching the broader AI-power theme.
brief_zh: Constellation 凭借核电 PPA 动量保持前列，尽管 CAISO 共址项目撤回波及整体 AI 电力主题。

brief_en: Symbotic drops as 13F trims compound; the alert stays negative until positions are re-established.
brief_zh: Symbotic 因 13F 减持叠加而下行；在持仓回补前，警报维持负面。
